LanguageData.LP_BeastKingHeart.label: beast king heart
LanguageData.LP_BeastKingHeart.description: The heart left behind by a dead elite beast, still slowly beating. Can be made into a beast king amulet at the enchanting table, and traders pay a good price for it.
LanguageData.LP_BeastKingAmulet.label: beast king amulet
LanguageData.LP_BeastKingAmulet.description: An amulet made from a beast king heart with gold and silver, hung at the waist. The wearer gets +10% melee damage and +2 Animals.
